cheng li: Heads up — partner_ops_bot flagged a perf regression when running CUDA 12.3 + NV driver 545 on marketplace AMIs. Seeing ~20-30% tail latency increase on some attention kernels.
partner_ops_bot: Partner ticket: https://partners.example/ticket/3421 — repro attached (logs + perf runs). Notified HW partner.
maria gonzalez: Which models and modes are affected (fp16 vs int8 vs bf16)? Is this runtime kernel fallback or driver/kernel-level?
julian park: Repro on resnet-lm-1b and llama-2-7b quantized fp16 path. Looks like NAPI/kernel fallback to slower codepath. Quick log excerpt:```WARN kernel-launch: blockDim(256) gridDim(1024) returned deprecated-sync, falling back
WARN cuLaunchKernel: elapsed 0.023s > baseline 0.012s (545)
```
rachel t: We should consider pinning marketplace AMIs to driver 535 as a short-term mitigation and canary 535 images for new customers. Also need a routing fallback in runtime if a model sees degraded perf.
samir khan: Proposal: (1) create a canary marketplace image pinned to 535, (2) add a runtime policy that routes affected models to pinned images, (3) coordinate with HW partner for signed runtime build with micro-opts. AMI build command (local):
```
ami-builder --base ubuntu-22.04 --set-driver 535 --tag marketplace-canary-2026-03-22
```
I'll own the AMI build and release notes.
cheng li: Julian — can you run perf matrix vs driver 535 and 545 on p4d and a100 hardware profiles? Need latency (p50/p95/p99) and throughput. ETA?
julian park: On it. Starting jobs now; ETA ~4h. Will post artifacts and flamegraphs to the ticket.
partner_ops_bot: HW partner acknowledged. They offered a signed runtime candidate with micro-optimizations; testing window ~24h. Added to ticket 3421.
maria gonzalez: Ops checklist for this thread: 1) create canary AMI pinned to 535, 2) add runtime fallback routing for affected model tags, 3) run perf matrix and validate on Dedicated pools, 4) prepare customer-facing note + opt-in canary for Marketplace, 5) if partner provides patch, validate and prepare joint release plan.
rachel t: Timeline suggestion — canary AMI + runtime fallback by COB tomorrow; if partner patch arrives, coordinate a hotfix release next week. Need SRE oncall for deploy window and rollback playbook. :calendar:
samir khan: I'll open PR in marketplace-ami repo with build metadata + release notes, pinging @julian @rachel for validation. Will also draft the customer opt-in message. :white_check_mark:
partner_ops_bot: Will post follow-up once partner finishes internal validation (target T+24h) and update ticket. Next thread update or new thread will include perf artifacts.
